tour.title: Xuan QiZhengSiYu Guided Tour
tour.description: A deep dive into the architecture and implementation of the QiZhengSiYu metaphysical calculation system.

steps.title: Project Overview
steps.description: Xuan QiZhengSiYu is a sophisticated metaphysical calculation system built with Flutter. It implements traditional Chinese 'Qi Zheng Si Yu' (Seven Luminaries and Four Concealed Stars) astrology, focusing on precision and modularity.

steps.title: Celestial Engines
steps.description: This is the heart of the system. The SwephEngine integrates the Swiss Ephemeris to provide high-precision astronomical data, which serves as the foundation for all subsequent metaphysical interpretations.

steps.title: Pattern Analysis (GeJu)
steps.description: The GeJu evaluation layer analyzes complex planetary configurations. It uses rule-based logic to identify specific astrological patterns, providing the qualitative insights traditional to Chinese astrology.

steps.title: MVVM Presentation
steps.description: The presentation layer follows the MVVM pattern. QiZhengSiYuViewModel coordinates between domain services and the reactive UI, ensuring that complex calculations don't compromise the user experience.
